bio.text: Geoff Luxenberg represents Manchester's 12th District in the Connecticut House of Representatives, and is a Deputy Speaker.
He previously represented Manchester from 2011 to 2015 before winning election again in 2018.
Before the legislature he served on the Manchester Board of Education and on the town's Commission for Elderly Services and People with Disabilities.
He co-chaired the Housing Committee during the 2023 session and is married with three children.
